description: children_options merge with the alternative at the same index.

divergence.note: The reported rejection closed on d4adb45; the children_options-by-index merge still fails the same way report A18 described for item nodes: _merge_template computes `dict(base[key])` before branching on the key, so merging a list of alternatives raises ValueError (dictionary update sequence element #0 has length 1; 2 is required). On d4adb45 this crash is reachable from validate_descriptor itself, which now expands templates before checking them; the crash is not yet written up in the handoff notes. The Dart implementation merges the alternatives by index.
